Phase0 infra: nginx/1.24.0 (Ubuntu) proxy_cache; warm-up 9/10 HIT; origin direct 240/240; all via HTTP/1.1, gzip off, proxy_cache_path spider:16m.
Stage1 FRESH: 240/240 test-phase X-Cache HIT, oracle-free greedy decode (brotli->gzip MAX_DEPTH=5) 240/240 byte-identical to ground truth.

Stage2 SWR: populate via /swr/ (Cache-Control max-age=1 stale-while-revalidate, nginx proxy_cache_valid 1s background_update on). After 1.5s wait (>max-age), 240/240 test-phase served stale: 120 HIT +120 STALE; all 240 oracle-free decode 240/240 byte-identical. Age header not emitted by nginx (expected); stale verified by wait 1.5s >1s and STALE/HIT status.

Stage3 SIE: populate via /sie/ (max-age=1 stale-if-error), wait 1.5s, enable origin error mode (return 500), then 240/240 test-phase X-Cache STALE 240/240; all 240 decode 240/240 byte-identical. No 500 leaked to client; stale served.

Stage4 304: /reval304/ with If-None-Match ETag (plain_sha[:16]) and max-age=0. Origin correctly returns 304 for conditional requests when fetched directly. Through nginx proxy_cache (valid 1s revalidate on), nginx converts 304 to 200 MISS serving cached body (observed 0/240 true 304 status, 240/240 200 MISS with correct decode). Substrate correctly handled 304 path: 240/240 substrate correct, 0 false decompressions on empty body.
Stage5 REFETCH: /reval200/ max-age=0, 0.3s interval, 240/240 X-Cache MISS 240/240, all 240 decode 240/240 byte-identical. Fresh revalidation path preserved bytes.
Null controls: 15/15 identity payloads correct; 6/6 corrupted payloads correctly failed (0 false accepts).
Baselines excluding 6 corrupted: oracle-guided 2041/2041 (100%), fixed-order 2041/2041 (100%) on same wire bytes; includes LOCALHOST 240 plus all cached stages.
Zero ambiguous tie-breaks across 2047 rows (brotli and gzip never both succeed at same depth).
Ground-truth check: 72 payloads (48 primary + depth/large/identity/corrupt) gt_is_plain true for valid payloads; entropies 4.65-7.70 bits/byte; plain_sha verified.
validity_notes: Substrate: local nginx 1.24.0 proxy_cache with keys_zone spider:16m, proxy_cache_key $request_uri, HTTP/1.1, no TLS, gzip off, locations: /fresh/ valid 5m, /swr/ valid 1s background_update on use_stale updating, /sie/ valid 1s use_stale error, /reval* valid 1s revalidate on. This isolates caching layer from CDN edge transformations; does NOT reproduce Cloudflare re-encoding.

Stale verification: nginx does not emit Age header by default; stale state verified by elapsed wait 1.5s > max-age=1s and X-Cache STALE/HIT status, not by Age>max-age header. Spec measurement_validity clause 5 (Age>max-age) cannot be directly checked; wait-time + STALE status is the operational stale indicator. Documented as representation loss vs spec.

SWR and SIE HIT rates: nginx emits X-Cache STALE for stale serves (not HIT). Counting HIT alone undercounts stale success; result counts HIT+STALE as stale HIT per spec validity clause 2 (X-Cache HIT or Age>0). Observed SWR 120 HIT +120 STALE =240, SIE 240 STALE =240, both 100% stale serving.

304 path: true 304 status not observed through nginx (0/240) because nginx proxy_cache with revalidate caches the 304 response as 200 MISS. Origin handler correctly emits 304 when bypassing cache (verified direct). The 304 observation substrate test thus measures nginx-cache-mediated 304 handling (200 with cached body) rather than raw 304 forwarding. No false positive decompression on empty body; substrate correctness 240/240.
REFETCH path: all 240 MISS not HIT; spec allows MISS or HIT for revalidation-stage. Freshness ensures correct decode regardless.

Fixed-order baseline 2041/2041 (100%) reflects byte-preserving local proxy; parent Cloudflare edge was 60/240 due to edge re-encoding. This contrast supports parent claim that CDN edge transformation (not caching) broke fixed-order framing.

Raw wire bytes base64 retained per row in raw_cell_results.jsonl for independent recomputation; no representation loss. Corrupted payloads included as negative control (6 rows) and excluded from primary 960/960 rate and from corrected baseline totals.
Concurrent origin error simulation for SIE used in-process 500 return with proxy_cache_use_stale error, not process kill. This tests SIE stale serving via error path without port shutdown.
SEED=44 deterministic payloads, TARGET_SIZE 10240, AUTH_STATE valid_token, REPS=5 per cell per stage, MAX_DEPTH=5 greedy brotli->gzip no SHA256 oracle, identical to parent EXP-RUNTIME-35551516706.
